title: The BEATS Dataset: Towards Understanding Music-Physiology Dynamics in Real-World Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2611.15837v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce the BEATS dataset, a robust compilation of psycho-physiological data collected in the wild from 30 participants while they listened to curated playlists intended to promote well-being. An acronym for Biomarkers, Experience and Affect from Therapeutic Soundscapes, the BEATS dataset aims to support research on wellbeing, music psychology, affective computing and signal processing. More specifically, this dataset includes: (1) sensor data collected during music listening sessions using a research-grade wearable device in free-movement environments; (2) music listening activity records, stimulus metadata, acoustic features, and self-reports associated with the listening sessions (3) individual characteristics, such as demographics, music preference, musical skills, and personality traits; and (4) self-reported psychological measures before and after their experimental participation spanning for a number of weeks. translated_title: BEATS数据集：迈向理解真实世界场景中音乐与生理的动态关系
translated_abstract: 我们推出BEATS数据集，这是一份在真实环境（in the wild）中收集的稳健的心理生理数据汇编，来自30名参与者在聆听旨在促进身心健康的精选播放列表时产生的数据。BEATS是“治疗性声音景观中的生物标志物、体验与情感”的缩写，该数据集旨在支持有关身心健康、音乐心理学、情感计算和信号处理的研究。更具体地说，该数据集包括：(1) 在自由活动环境中使用研究级可穿戴设备于音乐聆听会话期间收集的传感器数据；(2) 音乐聆听活动记录、刺激元数据、声学特征以及与聆听会话相关的自我报告；(3) 个体特征，如人口统计学信息、音乐偏好、音乐技能和人格特质；以及(4) 跨越数周的实验参与前后的自我报告心理测量数据。
tldr: BEATS数据集收集了30名参与者在真实环境中聆听音乐时的可穿戴传感器数据、聆听活动记录、个体特征及跨数周的心理测量数据，为身心健康、音乐心理学、情感计算和信号处理研究提供了宝贵的开放资源。
en_tdlr: The BEATS dataset compiles in-the-wild psycho-physiological data from 30 participants listening to wellbeing-promoting playlists, including wearable sensor data, listening records, individual characteristics, and longitudinal psychological measures, supporting research on wellbeing, music psychology, affective computing, and signal processing.
